Assignment.description: Assignment serializer with weekly hours support

personActive.description: false when the person has left: flag the assignment for reassignment.

completedAt.description: Set when the item closed or was removed in the provider.

CaAssignmentOutcomeEnum.description:
* `created` - Created
* `updated` - Updated
* `unchanged` - Unchanged
* `stale` - Older than the stored assignment
* `rejected` - Rejected

CaAssignmentRejectionEnum.description:
* `project_not_visible` - Project not visible to the user
* `project_not_bound` - Provider project not bound to the tracker project
* `person_not_found` - Person not found
* `person_inactive` - Person inactive

CaAssignmentWriteRequest.description: Assign or unassign one person on one item lineage (provider project, type and number).

trackerProjectId.description: The bound tracker project whose team the person was chosen from.

assignedAt.description: When the user made the change; the latest change wins.

index.description: Position of the row in the request.

CaBindingAssertionRequest.description: One local project entry's choice of tracker project for this provider project.

CaBindingOutcomeEnum.description:
* `recorded` - Recorded
* `unchanged` - Unchanged
* `conflict` - Conflicts with another user's binding
* `rejected` - Rejected

effective.description: The binding the tracker uses; on a conflict, the other user's choice.

CaBindingScopeEnum.description:
* `whole` - Whole project
* `base_build` - Base Build
* `tenant_fit_out` - Tenant Fit Out

CaCollectorRequest.description: The provider identity signed in on the desktop that made the scan.

CaCourtEnum.description:
* `you` - With you
* `us` - With your company
* `other` - Waiting on another company
* `none` - Nobody holds it

CaCoverageRequest.description: What one scan saw of one item type.

scannedAt.description: When this item type was scanned; the latest scan of an item wins.

detailsComplete.description: Every item of this type was read in full.

presenceVerified.description: The scan confirmed which items of this type exist, so removals can be applied.

fullSet.description: The items of this type across all parts are every item the desktop holds (first contact, resendAll, a collapsed outbox), not only changes. With presenceVerified, stored items of this type that are absent are removed.

itemCount.description: Items of this type after the scan.

CaDueGroupEnum.description:
* `overdue` - Overdue
* `today` - Due today
* `next7` - Due in the next 7 days
* `later` - Due later
* `none` - No due date
* `closed` - Closed

errors.description: Field errors when code is invalid, keyed like the request body.

CaErrorCodeEnum.description:
* `invalid` - The request body is invalid
* `unsupported_schema_version` - Update CA Tracker
* `observation_mismatch` - A part disagrees with earlier parts of the observation
* `ingest_disabled` - CA ingestion is turned off; retry later
* `not_implemented` - Not implemented yet

CaItemCompletion.description: Someone marked an open item complete in Workload Tracker; it is not yet closed in Helix or Procore.

providerItemId.description: The revision that was marked; a later revision is not covered.

markedByName.description: Who clicked it, when not the person themself.

dueDate.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the provider gives only a day, otherwise a date-time with an offset. Kept as sent so date-only values are not shifted by time zones.

createdDate.description: A date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the provider gives only a day, otherwise a date-time with an offset. Kept as sent so date-only values are not shifted by time zones.

scopeTag.description:
Base Build / Tenant Fit Out as detected by the desktop from number, title and contract.

* `base_build` - Base Build
* `tenant_fit_out` - Tenant Fit Out
* `unlabeled` - Unlabeled

sourceUrl.description: https link to the item or its list; dropped at ingest unless the host is allowlisted.

discipline.description: CA Tracker's discipline label; null when it has none. Leave the four CA Tracker fields out to keep what is stored.

disciplineSource.description:
detected, or set by hand (set with a null discipline means set to none).

* `detected` - Detected by CA Tracker
* `set` - Set by hand

folderStatus.description:
Where the item's CA folder stands, from CA Tracker's folder comparison.

* `open` - Open
* `ready_to_return` - Ready to return
* `reopened` - Back in court; the folder is in Returned
* `duplicate` - More than one folder
* `ambiguous` - Folder matches several items
* `not_in_provider` - Not in Helix or Procore
* `no_folder` - No folder
* `filed` - Returned
* `not_in_view` - Not in the last Procore view
* `no_data` - Not synced yet

folderPath.description: The item's folder relative to the project's CA folder.

CaItemRow.description: One CA item as Workload Tracker lists it, seen by the signed-in person.

dueDate.description: The business day it is due.

dueRaw.description: The provider value as sent (a day or a date-time).

daysTillDue.description: Business days until due; negative when overdue.

reasons.description: Why it is on My Work; empty on a project list.

completions.description: Who marked this revision complete here.

completedAt.description: When the signed-in person marked it complete.

canComplete.description: The signed-in person is assigned to it or holds it.

linkUrl.description: The item in Procore or Helix; Helix items link to the project list.

CaItemRowReason.description: Why an item is on the person's My Work.

text.description: For example "Assigned to you by Pat Lead" or "In your court in Helix".

CaItemScopeTagEnum.description:
* `base_build` - Base Build
* `tenant_fit_out` - Tenant Fit Out
* `unlabeled` - Unlabeled

CaMyItemReasonEnum.description:
* `assigned` - Assigned to you
* `court` - In your court

stored.description: Items created or changed by this part.

stale.description: Items skipped because a later scan is already stored.

removed.description: Items removed; non-zero only once the observation is applied.

CaObservationPartRequest.description:
One part of one scan of one provider project (decision D7).

Every part repeats the envelope. Parts are stored as they arrive; completeness,
removals and counts are applied when the last part has arrived.

observationKind.description:
items for bound or tracked projects; catalog (counts only) for every other project.

* `items` - Items
* `catalog` - Catalog

removed.description: Items gone since the last scan; applied on the last part when presence is verified.

resendAll.description: Send complete observations of every project again.

resendAfterSeconds.description: When resendAll is true: wait this long first, so desktops do not resend at once.

CaObservationStatusEnum.description:
* `pending` - Waiting for more parts
* `applied` - All parts received and applied

links.description: One per person sent, in the same order.

CaPersonLink.description: Who a provider identity is linked to now, and how (null when it is not linked).

CaPersonLinkRejectionEnum.description:
* `no_identity` - Neither a provider user id nor an email
* `person_not_found` - No such person
* `person_inactive` - The person has left
* `protected` - Linked automatically to their own sign-in; change it in Django admin

CaPersonLinkSourceEnum.description:
* `auto` - Their own sign-in in CA Tracker
* `manual` - Linked by hand
* `email` - Matching email

CaPersonLinkWriteRequest.description: A Helix or Procore person as the desktop sees them.

personId.description: The person to link to; null to unlink.

CaPersonRefRequest.description: A Helix or Procore person as the desktop sees them.

completions.description: Open items of the project that people marked complete in Workload Tracker.

bound.description: A Helix or Procore project is bound to it in CA Tracker.

total.description: Every matching item; items holds the first 2000.

host.description: Provider host, e.g. app.procore.com or project.helixteam.com.

accountId.description: Procore company id; null for Helix.

DisciplineSourceEnum.description:
* `detected` - Detected by CA Tracker
* `set` - Set by hand

FolderStatusEnum.description:
* `open` - Open
* `ready_to_return` - Ready to return
* `reopened` - Back in court; the folder is in Returned
* `duplicate` - More than one folder
* `ambiguous` - Folder matches several items
* `not_in_provider` - Not in Helix or Procore
* `no_folder` - No folder
* `filed` - Returned
* `not_in_view` - Not in the last Procore view
* `no_data` - Not synced yet

Person.description: Person serializer with department and role integration

PersonSkillSummary.description: Lightweight serializer for person skill summaries

max_per_project.description: Maximum number of assignments allowed for this role per project. Null means no limit.
